text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Ah, the day has finally come!
The brain juices... they just won't stop!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: The race I've always dreamed of...! The very first GⅠ, the Takarazuka Kinen, where my absolute faves Opera O-san and Doto-san stand side-by-side...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Let's go, Trainer!
With penlights stuck all over our heads!
And so, we arrived at Hanshin Racecourse. The first showdown between T.M. Opera O and Meisho Doto turned into a ferocious battle.

text_block_list.name: Opera O & Doto
text_block_list.text:
Deyaaaaaaaaaaaaaa!
Teyaaaaaaaaaaaaaa!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
TM Opera O moves up on the outside!
In second place on the inside, Meisho Doto!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Crossing the finish line side by side!
The winner is T.M. Opera O!
In second place, Meisho Doto!
(WAAAAAAAAAAAAH!!)

"A match race between two titans. The one who clinched victory
by the narrowest of margins was T.M. Opera O."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Calling that... "precious" doesn't even begin to cover it... right just now...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"It went far beyond anything like that...
My faves... putting everything on the line, clashing against each other... and then..."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"To think that *I*... completely forgot about moe...
It was that intense..."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant* Well done on making it this far, Doto.
All the way up to this canopy where I stand.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
This is our promised encounter. And
our story begins right here!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
There's no one ahead of you—except me!
And there's no one ahead of me—except you!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Opera O-san! I'm truly, truly sorry
for keeping you waiting soooo long!!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Still, I've made it this far.
Aiming for Opera O-san, stepping forward one by one...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"I want to become the person I've always looked up to!
So, pleeease take good care of me from now on!!"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Please run with me again and again,
over and overrrr!
(UOOOOOH!!)

The venue erupted into absolute pandemonium at the two declaring themselves rivals.
And then—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Is this... an Umamusume-chan...?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"Or... is it because it's Opera O-san
and Doto-san?"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Inside my ears... it's so hot...
Feels like something's about to pop out...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
It's because it's a fated showdown, right?
There's definitely something special just between those two...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Digital-kun, thank you for coming to see
our debut performance today.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Next is your turn.
Show me the dance of the Sand Princess.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Opera O-san...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Good luck. I'll be sure to learn a lot
from your dirt race, Digital-san.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes. Though I don't know if I can put on
a race as divine as the two of them!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Still, this live—I mean, race gave Digi-tan so much power!

And so, the baton was passed to the "Japan Dirt Derby."
In pursuit of the reason behind the Umamusume's burning passion.
